author: Dick Cook
title: Law and Order Oct. 1 - NewsBreak
text:
By Dick Cook ,
9 hours ago The following information is courtesy of the East Ridge Police Department. 26-009437-4300 BLK Spriggs Street-Drug Overdose/Arrest/Search Warrant – Police responded to the listed address for a possible overdose and found the intoxicated male resident inside his bedroom. Drug paraphernalia was in plain view. ERPD had responded to the home several times in the past few days on similar incidents. The man actively resisted officers when they attempted to detain him and he had to be taken down to the ground to handcuff him. The party was transported to Hamilton County jail and booked for Resisting. Officers then obtained a search warrant for the man’s room inside the residence due to repeated overdose calls at the residence and the plain view paraphernalia. The search warrant produced several pieces of drug paraphernalia, six grams of methamphetamine, 6.6 grams of fentanyl and several pieces of drug paraphernalia. Arrest warrants are pending for Possession of Methamphetamine, Possession of Fentanyl, and possession of drug paraphernalia. Read full article
